content: गर्भः [गॄ-भन् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 152</ls>] .²1 The womb, the belly; गर्भेषु वसतिः <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; पुनर्गर्भं च संभवम् <ls>Ms. 6. 63</ls>. .²2 A foetus, embryo; act of conception, pregnancy; conception; नरपतिकुलभूत्यै गर्भमाधत्त राज्ञी <ls>R. 2. 75</ls>; गर्भोऽभवद्भूधरराज- -पत्न्याः <ls>Ku. 1. 19</ls>; गर्भं वहति <ls>Pt. 1. 30</ls> bears a child in the womb. .²3 The time of conception; गर्भाष्टमेऽब्दे कुर्वीत ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनम् <ls>Ms. 2. 36</ls>. .²4 The child (in the womb); <ls>Ś. 6</ls>; ततः कुमारं सुरंगर्भक्ल्पम् <ls>Bu. Ch. 2. 19</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> ‘गर्भो भ्रूणेऽर्भके कुक्षौ’ <ls>Med.</ls> .²5 A child, brood or offspring of birds. .²6 The inside, middle, or interior of anything (in <ab>comp.</ab> in this sense and translated by ‘full of’, ‘filled with’, ‘containing’ <ab>&c.</ab>); हिमगर्भैर्मयूखैः <ls>Ś. 3. 4</ls>; शुक˚ कोटर <ls n="Ś.">1. 14</ls>, <ls n="Ś.">7. 7</ls>; ˚पत्रम् <ls>U. 3. 5</ls> inwardly situated; अग्निगर्भां शमीमिव <ls>Ś. 4. 4</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 9</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 17</ls>, <ls n="R.">9. 55</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 62</ls>; <ls>Māl. 3. 12</ls>; <ls>Mu. 1. 12</ls>. .²7 The offspring of the sky, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the vapours and fogs drawn upwards by the rays of the sun during 8 months and sent down again in the rainy season; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ms. 9. 305</ls>; नवमासधृतं गर्भं भास्करस्य गभस्तिभिः <ls>Rām. 4. 28. 3</ls>. .²8 An inner apartment, a lying-in-chamber. .²9 Any interior chamber. .²10 A hole. .²11 Fire. .²12 Food. .²13 The rough coat of the jack-fruit (पनसकण्टक). .²14 The bed of a river, especially of the Ganges on the fourteenth day of the dark half of Bhādrapada or in the very height of the rains when the river is fullest. .²15 The fruit (of plants). .²16 Joining, union. .²17 The calyx of a lotus. .²18 (In dramas) One of the {%Sandhis%} <ab>q. v.</ab>
